# Streamlabs triggers

## Charity donation

Runs when someone gives to a charity campaign you run on Streamlabs. Good for a special thank-you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who gave |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | The message they wrote |
| `%charityName%` | The name of the charity |
| `%campaignId%` | The campaign this gift belongs to |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.charityDonation`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Streamlabs. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to Streamlabs. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.disconnected`</small>

## Donation

Runs when someone donates through Streamlabs. Great for a thank-you message or an alert.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who donated ("Anonymous" if unknown) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | The message the donor wrote |
| `%donationId%` | The number Streamlabs gave this donation |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.donation`</small>

## Relayed bits

Runs when Streamlabs passes on someone cheering bits. Only runs if you tick the "Also publish..." box for Streamlabs on the Donations page (off by default, because your streaming site already reports it).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum bits** | Only run when at least this many bits were cheered. Leave 0 for any amount. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who cheered |
| `%bits%` | How many bits |
| `%message%` | Their message |

<small>Type id: `streamlabs.bits`</small>
